title: ContractSet
description: A provider-owned descriptor registering one or more compatibility contracts. Points at local sources; never copies them. See docs/onboarding/openapi-compat.md.

candidate.description: Default generator for contracts in this set that do not declare their own.

generator.description: Names a reviewed, registered adapter (see modules/openapi-compat/adapters.py); an unregistered name fails closed rather than running arbitrary logic.

script.description: Repo-relative path to the provider's bundling script

output.description: Repo-relative path the bundler writes, copied out as the candidate

source.description: Repo-relative path to the already-bundled, contract-first OpenAPI document

id.description: Stable contract id, unique within this descriptor

type.description: Only 'openapi' is implemented by this module; protobuf/CRD are follow-on work

declaredArtifact.description: Repo-relative path to the committed, generated contract

matchPath.description: Regular expression scoping comparisons to this contract's operations within the declared artifact; omit to cover the whole document

oasdiffVersion.description: Exact pinned oasdiff version; verified against the binary's embedded Go module version, not just --version

yqVersion.description: Exact pinned mikefarah/yq version; verified before descriptor parsing and candidate generation

severityOverrides.description: Maps an oasdiff rule id (see `oasdiff checks changelog`) to an overridden severity
